nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $I$ an ideal of $A$. The kernel of the ring homomorphism $A[X] \to (A/I)[X]$ that reduces every coefficient modulo $I$ is the ideal of $A[X]$ generated by the constant polynomials $a$ with $a \in I$.

nodes.summary: Maximal ideals of a monogenic algebra over a local ring contain the base maximal ideal, monic case. Let $A$ be a commutative local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m}$ and let $g \in A[X]$ be monic. Then every maximal ideal $M$ of $A[X]/(g)$ contains the ideal of $A[X]/(g)$ generated by the image of $\mathfrak{m}$.
nodes.title: Maximal ideals of a monogenic algebra over a local ring contain the base maximal ideal, monic case

nodes.summary: Maximal ideals of an integral monogenic algebra over a local ring contain the base maximal ideal. Let $A$ be a commutative local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m}$, let $g \in A[X]$, and suppose that $A[X]/(g)$ is integral over $A$. Then every maximal ideal $M$ of $A[X]/(g)$ contains the ideal of $A[X]/(g)$ generated by the image of $\mathfrak{m}$.
nodes.title: Maximal ideals of an integral monogenic algebra over a local ring contain the base maximal ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m}$, and for $f \in A[X]$ write $\bar{f}$ for its image in $(A/\mathfrak{m})[X]$. Let $g, q \in A[X]$ be such that $\bar{q}$ is irreducible in $(A/\mathfrak{m})[X]$ and $\bar{q}$ divides $\bar{g}$. Then the ideal of $A[X]/(g)$ generated by the image of $\mathfrak{m}$ and the class of $q$ is maximal.
nodes.title: Residual irreducible factors give maximal ideals of a monogenic algebra

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m}$, and let $B$ be a commutative $A$-algebra that is integral over $A$. Then every maximal ideal $M$ of $B$ contains the ideal of $B$ generated by the image of $\mathfrak{m}$.
